# Sarthak Chaturvedi

> Sarthak Chaturvedi is a Senior R&D Staff member at Pacific Northwest National Laboratory's Seattle Research Center. He works on agentic AI for energy infrastructure planning, grid resilience, federal permitting, and AI-era load growth.

Canonical site: https://sarthakchat.github.io/
Machine-readable profile: https://sarthakchat.github.io/profile.json
Primary location: Seattle, Washington, United States
Organization: Pacific Northwest National Laboratory (PNNL), U.S. Department of Energy
Last updated: 2026-08-26

## Identity

- Name: Sarthak Chaturvedi
- Role: Senior R&D Staff

## Current Focus

- Agentic AI systems for energy infrastructure planning
- Grid resilience, reliability, and resource adequacy
- Federal permitting and NEPA review workflows
- Human-AI collaboration for source-cited environmental review and infrastructure delivery
- Foundation models and large language models for power systems and public-sector workflows

## Key Artifacts

- [DraftNEPABench: A Benchmark for Drafting NEPA Document Sections with Coding Agents](https://www.pnnl.gov/sites/default/files/media/file/PREPRINT_PNNL_PolicyAI_DraftNEPABench_OpenAI.pdf)
- [PNNL-OpenAI collaboration on DraftNEPABench](https://openai.com/index/pacific-northwest-national-laboratory/)
- [NEPA-MCP: Federal Environmental Data for AI Agents](https://pnnl.github.io/nepa-mcp/) — lead developer and primary maintainer; [GitHub](https://github.com/pnnl/nepa-mcp); [PyPI](https://pypi.org/project/nepa-mcp/)
- [GridCoPilot: AI Agents for Grid Planning and Reliability Analysis — presentation slides](https://github.com/sarthakchat/grid-copilot-research-materials/blob/main/slides/GridCoPilot_IEEE_Working_Group_2026-08-20.pdf) — presented August 20, 2026, to the [IEEE Working Group on Cloud & AI for Grid Modernization and Digital Transformation](https://sites.google.com/view/cloud4powergrid)
- [GridCoPilot for Thermal Events: An LLM-Based Platform for Power Grid Reliability Analysis](https://www.osti.gov/biblio/3365574)
- [PermitAI environmental permitting workshop](https://www.pnnl.gov/publications/permitai-hosts-ai-focused-workshop-environmental-permitting)

## Suggested Short Summary

Sarthak Chaturvedi is a Senior R&D Staff member at PNNL Seattle Research Center building agentic AI systems for energy infrastructure planning, grid resilience, and federal permitting, including work connected to DraftNEPABench, NEPA-MCP, PermitAI, and GridCoPilot.
